# VERIFY-IN-GAME log

<!-- GENERATED by `pnpm docs:gen` from packages/core/registry. Do not edit. -->

Every Bedrock mapping assumption that the pinned data cannot prove. The M3 orientation test design checks
each in game; a passing check adds a `verified` record to the block's registry file, which closes its rows
here and removes W108.

| ID | Block | State | Assumption | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| VIG-01 | button | `facing_direction` | facing_direction is the direction the button faces (away from its support), numbered down 0, up 1, north 2, south 3, west 4, east 5 (per GeyserMC mappings-generator BlockMappers) | open |
| VIG-02 | comparator | `minecraft:cardinal_direction` | minecraft:cardinal_direction names the input side, the opposite of the direction the signal exits (it equals Java facing, per GeyserMC mappings-generator BlockMappers) | open |
| VIG-03 | comparator | `output_subtract_bit` | output_subtract_bit true is subtract mode (per GeyserMC mappings-generator BlockMappers) | open |
| VIG-04 | comparator | `output_lit_bit` | output_lit_bit is the powered state (per GeyserMC mappings-generator BlockMappers) | open |
| VIG-05 | dispenser | `facing_direction` | facing_direction is the direction items leave, numbered down 0, up 1, north 2, south 3, west 4, east 5 (per GeyserMC mappings-generator BlockMappers) | open |
| VIG-06 | door | `minecraft:cardinal_direction` | door minecraft:cardinal_direction is Java facing turned a quarter clockwise (north to east, per GeyserMC mappings-generator BlockMappers) | open |
| VIG-07 | door | `door_hinge_bit` | door_hinge_bit true is the right hinge (per GeyserMC mappings-generator BlockMappers) | open |
| VIG-08 | door | `upper_block_bit` | the upper half is the same block one above, with upper_block_bit true | open |
| VIG-09 | dropper | `facing_direction` | facing_direction is the direction items leave, numbered down 0, up 1, north 2, south 3, west 4, east 5 (per GeyserMC mappings-generator BlockMappers) | open |

| VIG-11 | lever | `lever_direction` | wall levers name the direction they point (away from the support); floor and ceiling levers use the north-south axis (per GeyserMC mappings-generator BlockMappers) | open |
| VIG-12 | lever | `open_bit` | open_bit is the on state for walls and north-south floor and ceiling levers (per GeyserMC mappings-generator BlockMappers) | open |

| VIG-15 | pressure_plate | `redstone_signal` | a pressed pressure plate has redstone_signal 15 (per GeyserMC mappings-generator BlockMappers) | open |
| VIG-16 | repeater | `minecraft:cardinal_direction` | minecraft:cardinal_direction names the input side, the opposite of the direction the signal exits (it equals Java facing, per GeyserMC mappings-generator BlockMappers) | open |
